show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/gcnpAD
show.description: Kabir is an ordinary man abandoned by his wife for a wealthy man and his family, leaving Kabir to raise their infant daughter Jiya alone. A mysterious Super Dad Reward System activates, testing Kabir’s love and sacrifice for ten years. When Jiya’s own mother returns, ready to trade her daughter’s life for power and status, Kabir is forced to stand against the most painful enemy of all.
